headline: Reviewed and edited the first goal of the 2019 Draft Strategic Action Plan; review to continue at future meetings.
summary: Members reviewed the existing goals in the 2019 Draft Strategic Action Plan to see if they were still relevant. The first goal and its action steps were edited as a group. The item will be a regular agenda item, with a review targeted for early Spring 2027.
decisions: Will add updating the 2019 Draft Strategic Action Plan as a regular agenda item at future meetings, with a review targeted for early Spring 2027.

decision_evidence.quote: This item will be added as a regular agenda item to future meetings, with a goal to complete a review by early Spring 2027.
